first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: crowd of spectators along the route
entities.identification: A collection of background spectators distributed along the track and barriers, excluding the separately numbered Person C and Person D; individual identities are not treated as the same across different route sections.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The first-person rider, with both black long-sleeved arms and both white-gloved hands visible in the foreground.

entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: The bicycle operated by Person B, with a black flat handlebar, a heavily treaded front tire, a red front component, and cables visible.

entities.name: track surface
entities.identification: The gray intersection ridden through in the current clip and the narrow light-brown platform against the wall on the right.

entities.name: metal barriers along the route
entities.identification: Gray framed barrier sections separating the spectators from the passage area, with mesh and horizontal bars locally visible.

entities.name: wall beside the track
entities.identification: The reddish-brown wall surface on the right, the light-colored wall pillar, and the base of the wall beside the gate.

entities.name: residential buildings along the route
entities.identification: The light-brown multistory residence at the upper right and the light-colored low-rise building in the distance along the passage.

entities.name: blue sky
entities.identification: The blue sky visible above the buildings and vegetation, with thin white clouds in places.

entities.name: vegetation along the route
entities.identification: Green tree crowns, clusters of leaves, palm-like crowns along the route, and a small amount of grass at the base of the wall.

entities.name: track promotional banner
entities.identification: Long banners with black or light-colored backgrounds and conspicuous graphics and text in front of the barriers.

entities.name: orange-and-white traffic cone
entities.identification: A collection of traffic cones beside the track, composed of orange cones with white horizontal bands.

entities.name: utility poles along the route
entities.identification: Slender upright poles near the intersection and narrow passage, some with attachments on their shafts.

entities.name: cables along the route
entities.identification: Multiple dark overhead lines in the sky area, including parallel, crossing, and curved segments.

entities.name: hard ground outside the track
entities.identification: The lower gray street surface on the left side of the narrow platform beside the gate.

entities.name: white gate with vertical bars
entities.identification: The large gate on the right side of the narrow platform, composed of adjacent white vertical bars, with a small handle visible nearby.

entities.name: Person C
entities.identification: The standing person at the base of the right wall wearing a dark blue short-sleeved top, light gray shorts, and dark shoes, located to the image-left of Person D.

entities.name: Person D
entities.identification: The spectator to the image-right of Person C wearing a white short-sleeved top, with both legs bent and the body positioned low, in a kneeling-seated posture.
